verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਪੇ੍ਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh man bach karam ikatr bhe pooran param padh peram pragaTaae hai ||

en.bdb: By virtue of the harmonious state of mind, words and actions, a Guru's disciple who is blessed with the loving elixir of Naam Simran, reaches a highly conscious state.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਚਨ ਮੈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਰਸ ਗੰਧ ਸੰਧਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੰਧ ਰਸ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: lochan mai dhirasaT dharas ras ga(n)dh sa(n)dh sravan sabadh surat ga(n)dh ras paae hai ||

en.bdb: By virtue of the fragrance of Naam relishment, he is blessed with True Guru-like glimpse. His ears perpetually hear His celestial music.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਮੈ ਰਸ ਗੰਧ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੇਲ ਨਾਸ ਬਾਸੁ ਰਸ ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਲਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: rasanaa mai ras ga(n)dh sabadh surat mel naas baas ras srut sabadh lakhaae hai ||

en.bdb: This harmonious integration of word and consciousness renders his tongue to be sweet and comfort-giving. The exhaling of his breath too is fragrant and reflects his high state of harmonious relationship between his mental faculties and Naam.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਰਸਨਾ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਨਾਸਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਪਿੰਡ ਪਾ੍ਰਨ ਮੈ ਜਤਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੫੩॥
verses.translit_en: rom rom rasanaa sravan dhirag naasaa koT kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd pi(n)dd paaran mai jataae hai ||53||

en.bdb: Thus by perpetual meditation on Him, with the relishing fragrance of Lord's name residing on his tongue, eyes, ears and nostrils, a Guru-conscious person realises the presence of Lord who abides in millions cosmoses within himself. (53)
